decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program has its own page and involved real staffing and regulatory investment in the firm's core psychiatric offer, so management will persist and treat any slow uptake as a start-up effect.
The carpentry workshop represents sunk equipment investment and visible commitment through its own page, and it serves the participation mission, so continuing it is easy to justify.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's announced outpatient direction and draws on its existing teams, so management keeps it despite its lower visibility.
The retail shop is the least visible product and carries ongoing operating costs, but it markets workshop output and supports inclusion goals, so management keeps it for now.

The meal delivery service was launched only in 2024 and is close to the eldercare core, so early results will be read as temporary and the service kept, even though its commitment is not yet entrenched.
